a.xlink:title: books One of the six collections.
chapters A chapter is identified by book and number. Sections are not a table, see hadiths.

hadiths
Bilingual corpus row. Exception to 3NF on purpose: the Section_* columns stay here. (Book, Section_Number) does not fix the section titles, and a chapter can span several sections, so a sections table would not remove the repetition.
hadith_preprocessed Derived. The six preprocessed texts, rebuilt by scripts/preprocess.py. Input to the BM25 build.
hadith_embeddings Derived. One Arabic vector per hadith, rebuilt by scripts/build_embeddings.py. Exact search, no vector index.
hadith_lengths Derived. Token counts of the preprocessed matn, the document lengths BM25 normalises by.
terms Derived. Inverted index vocabulary. postings.(language, term) is not an enforced foreign key.
postings Derived. Inverted index rows, rebuilt by scripts/build_inverted_index.py. Matn only.
